translations.idiomatic: (hereinafter abbreviated as New History of the Five Dynasties)]〉

sentences.zh: ，梁王即位在四月甲子，明年正月「弑濟陰王」。

translations.literal: , the Liang King ascended the throne on jiazi day in the fourth month; in the first month of the following year he "murdered the King of Jiyin."
translations.idiomatic: , the Liang ruler took the throne on jiazi day in the fourth month; in the first month of the next year he "murdered the King of Jiyin."

sentences.zh: 此系之四月朔，誤。

translations.literal: To place it on the new moon of the fourth month is an error.
translations.idiomatic: Placing the event on the fourth-month new moon is mistaken.

sentences.zh: 五：河東李克用卒卒字，據張校補。

translations.literal: 5: "Hedong Li Keyong died" — the character for "died," supplemented per Zhang Collation.
translations.idiomatic: 5: "Hedong Li Keyong died" — the word died is supplied per Zhang Collation.

sentences.zh: 六：皇后急遣蜀古魯救之蜀古魯，儀衛志四作曷古魯，是。

translations.literal: 6: "The Empress urgently dispatched Shugulu to rescue it" — Shugulu; Ceremonial Guards Record, vol. 4, reads Hegulu, which is correct.
translations.idiomatic: 6: "The Empress urgently sent Shugulu to the rescue" — for Shugulu, Ceremonial Guards Record, vol. 4, reads Hegulu, which is correct.

sentences.zh: 七：問諸弟面木葉山射鬼箭厭禳馮家升遼史初校

translations.literal: 7: Inquiring of the younger brothers, facing Mount Muye, shooting ghost-arrows for exorcism — Feng Jiasheng's First Collation of the History of Liao
translations.idiomatic: 7: "Inquiring of the younger brothers, facing Mount Muye, shooting ghost-arrows for exorcism" — Feng Jiasheng's First Collation of the History of Liao

translations.idiomatic: (hereinafter abbreviated as Feng Collation)]〉

sentences.zh: 云：問當作聞。

translations.literal: States: "inquire" should read "hear."
translations.idiomatic: states that inquire should read hear.

sentences.zh: 八：晉幽州節度使盧國用來降按此為次年二月盧文進來降之重出。

translations.literal: 8: "Jin's military governor of Youzhou Lu Guoyong came to surrender" — this duplicates Lu Wenjin's surrender in the second month of the following year.
translations.idiomatic: 8: "Jin military governor of Youzhou Lu Guoyong came to surrender" — this repeats Lu Wenjin's defection in the second month of the next year.

sentences.zh: 考異又論是時幽州節度使為周德威，不能同時又是盧國用。

translations.literal: Examination of Discrepancies further argues that at this time the military governor of Youzhou was Zhou Dewei, so he could not simultaneously be Lu Guoyong.
translations.idiomatic: Examination of Discrepancies adds that Zhou Dewei was governor of Youzhou at the time, so Lu Guoyong cannot have held the same post.

sentences.zh: 因文進為契丹平州節度使，遂誤以契丹所授之官為唐官。

translations.literal: Because Wenjin was military governor of Ping Prefecture under the Khitan, the Khitan title he was granted was mistakenly taken for a Tang office.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjin had been made Khitan governor of Ping Prefecture, and that Khitan appointment was wrongly recorded as a Tang office.

sentences.zh: 輯本薛居正五代史

translations.literal: Collated edition of Xue Juzheng's History of the Five Dynasties
translations.idiomatic: Collated edition of Xue Juzheng's History of the Five Dynasties

translations.idiomatic: (hereinafter abbreviated as Old History of the Five Dynasties)]〉

sentences.zh: 九七文進字國用，新五代史四八作大用。

translations.literal: Juan 97: Wenjin's courtesy name was Guoyong; New History of the Five Dynasties, juan 48, reads Dayong.
translations.idiomatic: Juan 97: Wenjin's courtesy name was Guoyong; New History of the Five Dynasties, juan 48, gives Dayong.

sentences.zh: 九：李嗣恩之子武八嗣恩，原誤「嗣本」。

translations.literal: 9: Li Si'en's son Wuba — Si'en; the original text erroneously read "Siben."
translations.idiomatic: 9: Li Si'en's son Wuba — for Si'en, the original erroneously read Siben.

sentences.zh: 按新、舊五代史李嗣本傳均不稱有子武八。

translations.literal: According to the biographies of Li Siben in the New and Old Histories of the Five Dynasties, neither mentions a son named Wuba.
translations.idiomatic: The biographies of Li Siben in the New and Old Histories of the Five Dynasties nowhere mention a son Wuba.

sentences.zh: 檢舊五代史五二李嗣恩傳：「有子二人，長曰武八┅┅戰契丹於新州，歿焉。

translations.literal: Checking Old History of the Five Dynasties, juan 52, Biography of Li Si'en: "He had two sons; the elder was called Wuba… he fought the Khitan at Xin Prefecture and died there.
translations.idiomatic: Old History of the Five Dynasties, juan 52, Biography of Li Si'en, reads: "He had two sons; the elder was called Wuba… he fought the Khitan at Xin Prefecture and died there.
